feature: Fix IQL tensor stacking and deck evaluator DB routing errors
workflow_rationale: Two independent runtime bugs in the training pipeline. Each requires a targeted code fix — one in tensor assembly logic, one in database table routing. No new features; the goal is to make existing training stages succeed.

phases.name: Fix IQL Tensor Padding
phases.description: Add zero-padding logic to build_iql_tensors_from_replay_db() so variable-length state/action embeddings are padded to a uniform max dimension before torch.stack()

subtasks.description: Add padding logic to dataset_adapter.py: after collecting all tensors, compute max_state_dim and max_action_dim, pad shorter tensors with zeros, update state_dim/action_dim in returned dict, and fix terminal-state zero padding (line 191) to use max_state_dim. Add warning log if dimensions are inconsistent, and a sanity-check warning if max_dim/min_dim > 2.0.

verification.command: python -c "import torch; from rl_agents.dataset_adapter import build_iql_tensors_from_replay_db; print('import OK')"

subtasks.notes: Key changes: (1) Define _pad_to() helper function. (2) After line 203 'if not s_list' check, compute max dims from s_list/a_list. (3) Pad s_list, a_list, s_next_list to uniform dims. (4) Update state_dim and action_dim to max values. (5) Terminal state zeros on line 191 will initially use first-row state_dim — these get corrected during the padding pass. (6) Log dimension info with [dataset] prefix. (7) Warn if max_dim/min_dim > 2.0 (possible data corruption). (8) Skip padding entirely if all dims already equal (no-op for consistent data).

phases.name: Fix Deck Evaluator DB Routing
phases.description: Fix the pipeline to pass the correct database (game_data.db with decks table) to the deck evaluator, and add defensive table-existence check in DeckWinDataset

subtasks.description: Fix DB path in run_local_pipeline.py line 310: change 'args._replay_db.db_path' to 'args._game_data_store.db_path' so the deck evaluator receives the correct database with the 'decks' table.
subtasks.notes: Changed args._replay_db.db_path to args._game_data_store.db_path on line 310 of run_local_pipeline.py. Verification passed.

subtasks.description: Add defensive check in DeckWinDataset.__init__() in deck_evaluator.py: before querying the 'decks' table, check it exists via sqlite_master, and raise a clear ValueError with guidance if missing (e.g., 'Database X has no decks table. Expected a GameDataStore DB like data/game_data.db').
subtasks.notes: Defensive check already implemented and committed in dd826fc. DeckWinDataset.__init__() checks sqlite_master for 'decks' table and raises ValueError with guidance if missing.

phases.name: Verification and Testing
phases.description: Run existing tests to verify no regressions, and validate both fixes work correctly

subtasks.description: Run the existing pytest test suite to verify no regressions from the changes to dataset_adapter.py, run_local_pipeline.py, and deck_evaluator.py.
subtasks.notes: All 29 relevant tests pass (test_local_pipeline.py + test_deck_validator.py). Collection errors in test_engine_game.py, test_talishar_adapter.py, test_talishar_comparison_normalization.py, test_transformer_policy_smoke.py are pre-existing (missing data files/modules unrelated to our changes).

subtasks.description: Verify DeckWinDataset defensive error: confirm that passing a DB without a 'decks' table to DeckWinDataset raises ValueError with a descriptive message instead of raw sqlite3.OperationalError.

verification.command:
python -c "import sqlite3, tempfile, os; db=tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db'); conn=sqlite3.connect(db); conn.execute('CREATE TABLE games (id INTEGER)'); conn.close(); print('temp db created'); from rl_agents.deck_evaluator import DeckWinDataset, CardVocab; vocab=CardVocab(); ok=False; exec('try:
 DeckWinDataset(db, vocab)
except ValueError as e:
 ok=chr(100)+chr(101)+chr(99)+chr(107)+chr(115) in str(e).lower()'); os.unlink(db); print('Defensive check OK' if ok else 'FAIL')"

subtasks.notes: This verifies the defensive error message works. Creates a temp DB without a decks table and confirms DeckWinDataset raises ValueError (not sqlite3.OperationalError).

parallel_groups.reason: Both depend on nothing (no dependencies), modify completely different files, and fix independent bugs
